label: 🧭 CRS / projection transform
description: Reproject coordinates between coordinate reference systems via pyproj. Convert lat/lon (EPSG:4326) into UTM zones, State Plane, Web Mercator, or any other EPSG code. Use when downstream tools expect projected coordinates (e.g. metres) or for accurate area / distance work in a specific region. Complements the built-in convert_coordinates which only handles WGS84↔ECEF cartesian.

sourceCrs.label: Source CRS
sourceCrs.help: Any pyproj-recognised string: EPSG code (EPSG:4326 = WGS84 lat/lon), PROJ string, or WKT. EPSG:4326 is the default for lat/lon data.

targetCrs.label: Target CRS
targetCrs.help: Any pyproj-recognised CRS. Common targets: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator, used by web maps), EPSG:32633 (UTM zone 33N), EPSG:2154 (Lambert-93 for France), EPSG:27700 (British National Grid).
